items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: I went with Manuel Perez... Well he was good. He was a good teacher.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. When you took up trumpet did somebody help you with that or did you just pick it up?

Well no I went under Chalini when I'd taken up trumpet. I stayed with Chalini about six months and I left him and I went with Manuel Perez. I went with Ole Man Adolf Alexander which we called North Byrne by the name of Taton. I stayed with him about three or four weeks. He was kind of rough. I had to leave him. When you miss your lessons he turned the head with me.
How was Manuel Perez? How did he teach?
